item.goal: Fix frontend/src/lib/format/money.ts so no formatter prints a negative zero: formatMicroUsd(-40) -> "$0.0000" (rounds to zero), formatTokens(-0.5) -> "0", formatTokens(-0) -> "0"; real negatives keep the sign (formatMicroUsd(-1234) -> "-$0.0012", formatMicroUsd(-2_500_000) -> "-$2.50", formatTokens(-1234) -> "-1,234").
